blocks.head: alt UserX is not near a device and the device exists
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX has key and the device exists
alt UserX is near the device and has signed key M
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY and Device
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < Device | (...) > $ UserX 'approach' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > < Device | (...) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > < Device | (...) > $ UserX 'leave' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < Device | (...) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : Device , 'key' : nils , ...) > < Device | ('key' : DeviceKey , ....) > $ UserX 'requestKey' Device 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : Device , 'key' : randomStr('Key', N) , ...) > < Device | ('key' : randomStr('Key', N) , ....) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Cloud | (Device : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) , 'secret' : Secret , ....) > $ UserX 'signKey' Cloud | (Device ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Cloud | (Device : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) , 'secret' : Secret , ....) > $ Cloud 'signedKey' UserX | (encrypt(Key, Secret)) .

eq < UserX | ('signedKey' : nils , ..) > $ Cloud 'signedKey' UserX | (SignedKey) 
= < UserX | ('signedKey' : SignedKey , ..) > .

ceq < UserX | ('near' : Device , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ..) > < Device | ('key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' Device | (SignedKey) 
= < UserX | ('near' : Device , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ..) > < Device | ('key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : (UserX , TrustedUsers) , ...) > if SignedKey == encrypt(Key, Secret) .

eq < Cloud | (Device : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'shareAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY) 
= < Cloud | (Device : ('trusted' : (UserY , TrustedUsers) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < Cloud | (Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , (UserY , Rest) , ..) , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY) 
= < Cloud | (Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, deviceB) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .
